# Bourns SF-1206F series CAD

Source: https://www.bourns.com/engineering/sf1206f/sf-1206f_series.stp

Downloaded September 29, 2026 from Bourns’ public engineering-files page. `sf-1206f_series.stp` is the unchanged manufacturer file (SHA-256 in provenance.json). `SF-1206F_KiCad.step` preserves its geometry, normalizes the seating datum and adds cosmetic face colors using `scripts/prepare-fuse-model.py`. Manufacturer geometry is not authored or MIT-licensed by Planar Studio. Bourns retains its rights; use is subject to the manufacturer’s terms: https://www.bourns.com/legal/disclaimers-terms-and-policies . CAD is a nominal design aid, not tolerance or assembly acceptance.
